projectDescription: A terminal-based Python calculator with natural language input, fraction arithmetic, equation solving, variable support, and meme mode.
keyFeatures: Natural language expressions (e.g., '9 squared', 'sqrt of 16', '5 cubed')
Exact fraction arithmetic with mixed-number support (e.g., '2 1/2 + 3/4')
Brute-force polynomial/quadratic/cubic solver for integer roots
Math functions: sqrt, sin, cos, tan, log, pi, e
Meme mode with easter-egg responses for famous internet maths
Web demo via index.html (JavaScript mirror of Python logic)
Installable as a PyPI package with 'calc-app' console script entry point
publicApiSurface: calc_app.evaluator.calc(expr: str)  — evaluate an expression string
calc_app.solver.solve_equation(equation: str)  — solve an equation string
calc_app.parser.parse_natural_language(expr: str)  — translate natural language to math
calc_app.fractions.parse_fractions(expr: str)  — rewrite fraction literals to Fraction() calls
calc_app.meme.handle_meme(line: str, meme_mode: bool)  — return meme response or None
calc_app.variables.variables  — dict of user-defined variable bindings
